summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  **What I found by reading the code (no changes made):**  - Server side (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `schema.ts`) is correctly scoped: every route requires a valid session, injects `X-User-Id` from the session, and every query filters by `user_id`/watchlist ownership. Sessions are DB-backed with a 30-day expiry, not in-memory, so they survive server restarts. - Client side (`WatchlistPage.tsx`) has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every read/write hits the API. The page only fetches once, on mount. - `App.tsx`'s `Router`
